DCO.description: Steel Design Code Options (DCO). Fields describe global steel design settings; seismic-related fields (SEIS_SYS, COL_WEAK) are applied only when SEISMIC is true.

DGNCODE.description: Design Code. Case-insensitive enum; wire values shown. Only 'KDS 41 30 : 2022' is accepted for this endpoint.

SEISMIC.description: Apply Special Provisions for Seismic Design. When true, SEIS_SYS and COL_WEAK are applied.

COMB_RATIO.description: Combined Ratio Method for Circular Section.

UNDGR_LD.description: Use Under Ground Load Combination Type for Under Ground Members.

SEIS_SYS.description: [SEISMIC=true] Seismic Load Resisting System. Applied only when SEISMIC is true. Case-insensitive enum; wire values shown.

COL_WEAK.description: [SEISMIC=true] Consider strong column-weak beam on last floor. Applied only when SEISMIC is true.
